main-window.description: The shipped meeting-notes window may run one local meeting flow: check readiness, request the two capture permissions, start and stop a meeting, name a meeting, edit an operator note, copy a transcript, manage exact local vocabulary replacements without rewriting retained transcript bytes, correct a displayed speaker name without rewriting the retained transcript, restore a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, open only the verified transcript file the operator selected, release a selected recording, delete a confirmed transcript and its generated notes, delete a confirmed meeting, open local completed notes with retained source passages, and regenerate a meeting note from its current transcript. It cannot use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

preview-window.description: The local Preview build exercises the same meeting-notes flow as the shipped window, including naming a meeting, editable personal notes, exact local vocabulary replacements without rewriting retained transcript bytes, bounded speaker-name correction, restoring a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, only the verified transcript file the operator selected, confirmed recording, transcript, or whole-meeting deletion, and regenerating a meeting note from its current transcript. It has no reference-interface, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.

settings-window.description: The Settings window may show and request the two local capture permissions, show the signed speech-model and note-model catalogs, install and activate catalog models, remove an inactive speech model, and remove the note model. It cannot read meetings or use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.
